_comment: Every refusal lib/email-sender.js makes, by name. refusalName is what a caller or a log reader tests; reason is what a person reads. <!detailText!> is filled with the setting or value concerned (never the Resend API key, never a password). A missing entry stops the server at load.

emailSenderNotConfigured.reason: this server has no [email-sender] section in startApiServer.ini, so it sends no mail

fromAddressNotOnSendingDomain.reason: [email-sender] fromAddress is not an address on sendingDomain (<!detailText!>); the provider would refuse it

redirectAddressNotValid.reason: [email-sender] redirectAllEmailTo is not an email address

recipientMissing.reason: a message needs at least one recipient

messageIncomplete.reason: a message needs a subject and a text or html body

providerRefused.reason: the mail provider refused the message: <!detailText!>

providerUnreachable.reason: the message could not be sent: <!detailText!>

providerAnswerEmpty.reason: the mail provider answered with neither an error nor a message id
